chains.title: Make your own gathering tool
chains.limits: Collect loose wood or use existing stock; buying is optional. Making spends wood and metered battery energy. Successful use measures dry soil or sand, not rock mining, wear or strength.

steps: Find a loose oak pile shown in Recipes → Personal field pick → Oak → Find in World.
Walk within 2 m and collect. Inventory shows your wood. Existing stock or optional Market purchases work too.
Choose Personal field pick in Recipes. Check Oak and Build status, then Make.
Fund the wood and workbench energy from available stock and a battery. No wallet deposit is required.
Finish the work and place it in the World, or put the finished item in Inventory.
Find your made tool and press E to equip it, or select its Inventory slot.
Aim at nearby dry soil or sand. The material thumbnail shows the target. Click or press J to use the tool.
A successful removal with your own made tool completes this goal and earns Gathering by hand.

chains.title: Put your camp to work
chains.limits: Tool use measures dry soil or sand. A work surface receives items; it does not unlock shaping. Machine batches use the declared recipe ledger, not simulated chemistry.

steps: In Skills, follow Go to tool. Pick it up with E, or equip it from your bag.
Choose Study tool / Inspect. The saved study goes in your own journal.
Equip your gathering tool. Find dry soil or sand near the tool location shown in Skills.
Aim at the ground and use the tool. A supported removal above zero earns Gathering by hand.
Find Work table in Recipes, or make another supported surface of at least 0.1 m².
Check supplies, then Make. The new table receives items with Place; it does not perform shaping.
Follow Your next action to a compatible machine and its available supplies.
Stop it before changing recipe. Store carried ground materials in Inventory, then load the selected machine input.
Use Power / Watch batch, turn it on and watch while nearby and facing it. Only an actual saved batch completes this goal.
